title: 12 Best Photography Spots in Cartagena
description: Discover Cartagena's most Instagrammable spots! From historic Walled City alleys to vibrant Getsemaní street art and stunning sunset views, capture the magic of Cartagena.

places.name: Walled City (Calle del Colegio & Adjacent Streets)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Vibrant colonial building facades, flower-draped balconies, intricate door knockers.

places.name: Getsemaní (Callejon Angosto & Plaza de la Trinidad)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Colorful street art murals, lively Plaza de la Trinidad scenes, illuminated alleys at night.

places.name: Castillo San Felipe de Barajas
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sweeping city panoramas from the top, intricate tunnel architecture, dramatic fortress ramparts.

places.name: Café del Mar (on the Walled City Ramparts)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sunset over the Caribbean, silhouettes against the sky, views of Bocagrande and the Walled City.

places.name: Convento de la Popa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sweeping vistas of Cartagena Bay, Bocagrande, and the Walled City. The historic courtyard of the convent.

places.name: Plaza de Bolívar & Palacio de la Inquisición
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The grand façade of Palacio de la Inquisición, the statue of Bolívar, pigeon feeding scenes, surrounding architecture.

places.name: Torre del Reloj (Clock Tower) & Plaza de los Coches
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Clock Tower facade, horse-drawn carriages, street performers, Palenqueras, archway views.

places.name: Muelle de los Pegasos (Pegasus Pier)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Walled City skyline from across the water, the Pegasus statues, boats in the harbor, night shots of the illuminated city.

places.name: Las Bóvedas
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Repeating arches and doorways, colorful artisan stalls, the historic ramparts above.

places.name: Plaza de San Pedro Claver
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The imposing Church of San Pedro Claver, modern metal sculptures, street vendors and performers.

places.name: Bocagrande Beach & Skyline
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Modern skyline reflecting in the water, beach scenes, the contrast between old and new Cartagena from a distance.

places.name: Rosario Islands (Day Trip)
places.priceRange: Boat tour prices vary, typically COP 100,000 - 250,000 (~$25 - $65 USD) excluding port fee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Turquoise waters, white-sand beaches, lush island vegetation, marine life (snorkeling/diving shots).
